component.name: Disc Image Studio
component.summary: Design and burn pictures visible on CD, DVD and Blu-ray discs

description.p: Disc Image Studio converts a picture into data that meets the physical-layer constraints of CD, DVD and single-layer BD-R discs. After burning, the recording side of the disc shows the picture to the naked eye.

ul.li: Arrange images as layers on a millimetre-accurate disc canvas
Tune dithering, brightness and gamma with a live engine preview
Generate CD-DA tracks (WAV + CUE), CD data images, DVD ISOs and BD-R ISOs
Optionally keep a readable folder of files on the disc next to the picture
Simulate read-back of the generated file before spending a disc
Burn with cdrecord, wodim, cdrskin, growisofs or xorriso
Projects are shared with the Windows version

description.p: Burning drawn data is experimental. Use blank, expendable media.
